Life Architecture

Protect life, character, mission, institution, impact, and legacy before optimizing rewards.

Capital Model

Track financial, institutional, knowledge, relationship, reputation, and human capital.

Threat Detection

Flag financial, legal, reputation, ethical, burnout, dependency, and mission-drift risks.

Strategic Focus

Keep no more than three primary strategic objectives active; defer, delegate, or reject the rest.

Decision Output

Choice Wheel Template

Situation

Summarize the decision, baseline, and objective without assuming the initial framing is correct.

Options

Generate 3–7 choices: accept, reject, negotiate, delegate, delay, transform, or create an alternative.

Scoring

Score strategic alignment, value, finance, institution, learning, network, reputation, probability, life quality, and risk protection.

Recommendation

Choose the highest long-term strategic value, explain why, define the next action, and name what not to do.
